text: Hear attentively: Heb. Hear in hearing
lightning: Heb. light | ends of the earth: Heb. wings of the earth
likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength: Heb. and to the shower of rain, and to showers of rain of his strength
Out of the south: Heb. out of the chamber | North: Heb. scattering winds
his bright cloud: Heb. the cloud of his light
